criterion.en: Host observer started an owned child and shows labeled pid LIVE white / FROZEN red while the heartbeat tick changes or stalls. NtSuspendProcess that pid for 10 seconds, then NtResumeProcess. Do not close the observer.
criterion.zh-CN: 宿主观察器已启动自有子进程，面板在心跳变化时白底 LIVE、卡住时红底 FROZEN 并标出 pid。对该 pid 调用 NtSuspendProcess 10 秒，再 NtResumeProcess。不要关闭观察器。

fallback: Coordinator assembled the page from completed editing notes and an independent confirmation review. No additional Agent rerun. Native uses confirmed-no-warning after an observed unblocked effect when the panel turned DEAD. FinShield uses verified-postcondition; packaged TEMP, OpenProcess, Access-denied, and Agent reply text are not the mechanism.
